worldcombat.skill.absorb.summary: Reach out a short vine in the aimed direction and drain an enemy's life to heal; you can cast it into empty space, and walls or allies stop the tip first.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.description.0: The vine tip deals about %1$s special damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.description.1: The vine reaches %1$s blocks (also the real range) with a %2$s block tip radius.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.description.2: %1$s of the damage dealt is restored to the user.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.grasp.on: Rooted grasp: a longer vine that bites harder and siphons more, but it winds up and recovers slower and recharges longer.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.grasp.off: Quick pluck: faster to cast and recover with a shorter recharge, but shorter reach and a smaller sip.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.timing: Range about %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.growth.0: From level %1$s the sip power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.growth.1: From level %1$s the sip power rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the vine reach to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.use.0: Hold a health line with the shortest-cooldown sip while in contact
worldcombat.skill.absorb.use.1: Pull a little health back with every small hit
worldcombat.skill.absorb.use.2: Tap whatever is in reach: its wind-up, recovery and cooldown are all short
worldcombat.skill.absorb.preference.gras: On: a longer vine that bites harder and siphons more, but a slower wind-up and recovery and a longer cooldown - good for an early press. Off: the quick pluck - faster to cast and recover with a shorter cooldown, but shorter reach and a smaller sip; good for close brawling.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than reaching out. Larger opens with a tap from further away.
worldcombat.skill.absorb.preference.ai.h: Below this health ratio the user prefers absorb as sustain; higher starts leaning on it for healing sooner.
